papers.title: CiteAnchor: Source-Aware Grounding for Hallucinated Citation Detection and Resolution
papers.summary: Introduces CiteResolve, a benchmark of 423 real-world hallucinated citations, and CiteAnchor, a source-aware grounding framework that adapts retrieval and field-level verification to each source type. It separately decides citation validity and whether a unique source can be recovered, beating web-search baselines by 16-65 points on end-to-end success.

papers.title: The Llama 3 Herd of Models
papers.summary: Meta's detailed report on the Llama 3 foundation models (up to 405B parameters), covering data curation, pre-training at scale, post-training with SFT/DPO, safety, and infrastructure. It also describes multimodal extensions and is a deep reference for how frontier open LLMs are built and aligned.
